source_semantics.route: The canonical source exposes @page /ai-center as an authenticated AI workspace.
source_semantics.authoritative_reads: The source metadata load reads the prompt registry and the current user's recent AI usage before rendering the AI Center summary and prompt library.
source_semantics.scope_boundary: Generate, Submit for approval, Refresh state, Usage link, Approval Queue link, New session, Copy output, prompt selection and history controls are separate canonical operations and are not claimed here.

laravel_adaptation.workspace_route: GET /tenants/{tenant}/ai-center is an explicit CanonicalWorkspaceRouteController::show route under web + auth + tenant.context with tenant.view and ai.use authorization.
laravel_adaptation.read_contract: GET /api/tenants/{tenant}/ai-center is GET-only, authorizes ai.use, reads enabled tenant-scoped AiPromptTemplate rows and counts up to the latest 100 AiUsageRecord rows belonging to the authenticated user.
laravel_adaptation.frontend_wiring: The existing frontend context normalization publishes the tenant-qualified ai-center API contract without replacing any server-advertised endpoint; the existing workspaceRoutes ai-center resource therefore leaves pending_integration and renders authoritative backend rows.
laravel_adaptation.truthful_empty_state: If the active tenant has no enabled prompt templates or the authenticated user has no usage records, the endpoint returns an empty collection and zero counts; it never seeds demo prompts or synthetic usage.

tenant_isolation.prompt_scope: AiPromptTemplate uses the existing BelongsToTenant global scope after tenant.context activation.
tenant_isolation.usage_scope: AiUsageRecord is tenant-scoped and is additionally filtered by authenticated user_id.
tenant_isolation.route_boundary: Foreign tenant workspace/API requests fail 404 through tenant.context; missing ai.use fails 403; guests fail closed before any tenant data is read.
tenant_isolation.id_surface: The route/read operation accepts no prompt, usage, site, approval, or user resource identifier from the caller.

proofs: exact canonical PENDING route identity and source metadata
explicit named workspace and API route/controller binding
auth + tenant.context + tenant.view + ai.use workspace enforcement
enabled active-tenant prompts are read from persistence
usage metadata is restricted to the authenticated user
disabled and foreign-tenant prompts are not disclosed
guest, permission-denied and foreign-tenant requests fail closed
read requests leave prompt and usage persistence counts unchanged
frontend endpoint is tenant-qualified and preserves a server-advertised authority
no sibling AI Center operation or mutation contract is claimed
